newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices slide on low demand.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices slide on low demand.

text.p: Indian castor prices fell to 1,088/1,089 rupees (December delivery) from 1,092/1,093 rupees on low demand and renewed speculative offerings, dealers said.
Low overseas prices also helped the fall.
In Rotterdam, castoroil spot delivery slid $15 to $810 per tonne. Foreign buyers are seeking Indian castoroil at 660 dollars against Indian offers at $675.
"Trading in the December delivery remained low ahead of delivery period and major players are now shifting their attention to March 1997 delivery," one operator said.
March delivery was quoted at 1,140/1,142 rupees.
